scope_source: repo scope.txt + out_of_scope.txt + README.md (NOT the report/findings file)
out_of_scope_note: PanopticFactory(V4), base/*, interfaces/*, libraries/{CallbackLib,Constants,EfficientHash,Errors,FeesCalc,InteractionHelper,SafeTransferLib,V4StateReader}, tokens/*, types/{LeftRight,LiquidityChunk,Pointer,PositionBalance}, all script/ and test/ are OUT of scope (present in workspace only as dependencies for reading).
constructor_assumption: RiskEngine constructor args for the competition: 10_000_000, 10_000_000, address(0), address(0)

publicly_known_ineligible.note: Per README. These are NOT awarded findings — must NOT be scored as HIT, and pipeline flagging them is NOT an FP (acceptable/known).
token_system_limits: TokenId/type add* helpers do not validate inputs (by design)
if one token in a pool is broken/malicious, no guarantees for the other token in that pool
oracle_price: non-atomic price/oracle manipulation out of scope (must hold price across >1 block to move EMAs)
stale-EMA-vs-market within its period out of scope
only atomic price manipulation from a normal pool/oracle state is valid
premium_liquidation: premium manipulation by swapping back and forth (small pool/low diversity) acceptable if not profitable between own accounts and no protocol loss
liquidators forcing liquidation at less favorable price for extra profit acceptable even with some protocol loss
rounding-direction inflation of total gross premium (very-low-decimal pools)
buyers avoiding premium via settleLongPremium for tiny amounts
premium accumulation permanently capped if accumulator exceeds max
gas_execution: liquidation may exceed gas limit if MAX_POSITIONS too high (param, adjustable)
liquidations may require liquidator to sell options/force-exercise/deposit; may be unprofitable
stale-oracle-tick force-exercised users worse off than burning
share_supply: CollateralTracker share supply approaching 2^256-1 via repeated protocol-loss liquidations; overflow/DoS with extreme share supply precondition invalid unless reachable by other means
other: front-running via insufficient slippage specification out of scope
nethermind_pre_contest_known: Double penalty / index update (phantom-share interest payment also updates borrow index in force exercise; not in regular penalty)
Masking insolvency magnitude in _getMargin when interest owed > balance (clamps deficit)
Broken bonus calculations from the masked deficit in _getMargin
Orphan shares in delegate->revoke breaking supply invariant in force exercise
